resources.string: Delay Google Photos backup during camera processing
If Google Photos appears stuck or cannot upload for a long time, tap below to immediately unblock and restore its network connection.

Waits until you leave the camera and ALL photos finish processing (>= 1MB, no temp files), plus the configured delay (min 30s). Reopening camera or taking another photo resets the timer.
⚠️ Please enable Auto-start and Allow Background High Power Usage in system settings so the OS does not kill this app.
⚡ One-Click Grant All Permissions via Shizuku

Current version: v%1$s (Automatically checks GitHub for APK updates on launch)

A rootless companion app (requires Shizuku) built for OPPO, vivo, and Xiaomi (Global & CN ROMs) to prevent Google Photos from prematurely uploading unfinished preview photos during camera processing.

P.S. vivo Global ROM OriginOS 7 (Android 17) already includes a built-in fix and can skip this app.
